title: Cosmic Fantasy Gathering
description: A surreal fantasy scene features a central armored warrior with a glowing blue sword standing on a stone platform surrounded by white flowers. To his left, a giant green dog-like creature stands beside a woman in a black and gold dress. To his right, a robed wizard with a blue beard holds a glowing staff beneath a dragon archway, while a green armored figure stands on a separate platform. A large red moon with the text 'F...' dominates the purple night sky filled with bubbles containing animals.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene at night with a giant red moon in a purple cloudy sky. In the center, a bearded warrior in ornate armor stands on a stone platform holding a glowing blue sword. To the left, a giant vibrant green dog with big eyes stands next to a woman in a black floral dress. To the right, a tall wizard with blue hair and beard holds a glowing staff under an archway topped with a skull, next to a golden dragon and a green armored figure. Floating bubbles with animals fill the sky, white flowers grow around broken stone pillars, cinematic lighting with purple and teal tones.
